title: WTO | WTO legal texts
content:
The 1986–94  Uruguay Round multilateral trade negotiations resulted in about two dozen  agreements, contained in four annexes to the
Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the World Trade  Organization
, signed in April 1994. Since their entry into force in  January 1995, portions of these agreements have been amended and rectified  several times and some were terminated.
The texts reproduced here do not have the legal standing of the original documents which are entrusted and kept at the WTO Secretariat in Geneva.
The WTO agreements contain rights and  obligations that apply to WTO members in general. Some of these agreements also  include “
”  of commitments specific to individual members.
When signing the Marrakesh Agreement,  ministers adopted the
Marrakesh Ministerial Declaration
to formally conclude the Uruguay Round. They  also signed a
Uruguay Round ministerial decisions and  declarations
Understanding on Commitments in Financial Services
These documents have been published in the
WTO Ministerial Conferences — Key Outcomes
publication. Together with the Marrakesh  Agreement, which was also annexed to the Final Act, they embody the results of  the Uruguay Round.

The Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies (the Agreement) was adopted by the WTO Ministerial Conference on 17 June 2022 (see
). The Protocol Amending the WTO Agreement done at Geneva on 17 June 2022 (the Protocol), inserting the Agreement into Annex 1A, is open for acceptance by WTO members and, in accordance with Article X:3 of the WTO Agreement and paragraph 4 of the Protocol, will enter into force once two thirds of the WTO members have deposited their instrument of acceptance. At that time, the Agreement will apply only to the WTO members that will have accepted it. In respect of each member that accepts the Agreement after its entry into force, the Agreement will take effect upon acceptance, in accordance with Article X:3 of the WTO Agreement.
